 2025:KER:31775 WP(C) NO. 31112 OF 2024  4  T.R. RAVI, J.
 --------------------------------------------
 W.P.(C) No.31112 of 2024  --------------------------------------------
 Dated this the 08th day of April, 2025  JUDGMENT
The main prayer in the writ petition is for granting compensation for the entire structure even though a portion alone been acquired.
The issue is covered by the judgments of this Court in WPC.No.14715 of 2024 and WA Nos.718 of 2024 and connected cases.
In the above circumstances, this writ petition is closed with liberty to the petitioner to move the arbitrator for appropriate relief as has been directed in the above said judgments.
The petitioner will be entitled to move an application under Section 17 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act in this case if required.

Sd/-
